name: SHROUD
description: SHROUD is the Underworld's most-followed anonymous curator — an identity or collective that has been active since at least 2204, broadcasting encrypted aesthetic transmissions through the deep net: part art review, part intelligence briefing, part confessional. SHROUD's transmissions dissect corporate media manipulation, expose corponation disinformation campaigns with documented evidence, and occasionally drop what appear to be raw surveillance feeds from Tier 5 spaces. Whether SHROUD is a single person, an E.L.F., a collective, or a corporate counter-intelligence operation is the defining question of Underworld discourse. Three separate individuals have claimed to be SHROUD; all three were subsequently discredited by SHROUD itself.
cultural_impact: SHROUD's verified document drops have directly influenced two corponation board-level scandals and are cited as a factor in the 2220 GLMZ Data Sovereignty Protests. In Underworld communities, 'getting SHROUDed' means having your disinformation publicly and irrefutably dismantled.
key_figures: The Three False SHROUDs (publicly discredited claimants)
Cipher Nakamura-Osei (Underworld analyst who has written the most credible deanonymization attempts)
locations: The Underworld (deep net, no physical anchor)
Dead-drop distribution nodes in Shelf Districts 3, 7, and 12
SHROUD transmissions have been physically printed and posted in Tier 2 transit hubs — origin unknown
story_hooks: SHROUD has transmitted what appears to be a partial deanonymization of themselves — either a mistake, a test, or a trap — and multiple parties including corponation security, Underworld bounty hunters, and at least one journalist are racing to follow the thread.

A player character receives a direct, private transmission from SHROUD containing information that is specifically, impossibly personal — information that no surveillance system should have — along with a single question and no context.

SHROUD's latest drop contains a document that, if real, implicates a beloved Tier 1 community figure in a long-running corponation informant arrangement. The community is fracturing between those who trust SHROUD and those who believe this particular drop is a planted fabrication.
platform: Encrypted Underworld broadcast (no registered identity or platform)
follower_count: Unverifiable; estimated 600K active Underworld subscribers; reach through redistribution unknown
controversy: In 2221, SHROUD broadcast what appeared to be an internal HelixMedia memo detailing a deliberate cancer cluster cover-up in Shelf District 9. HelixMedia's legal response — which neither confirmed nor denied the document's authenticity — was widely interpreted as confirmation. SHROUD has never commented on the document's source.
